item.title: American Breezy Johnson wins gold after Vonn crashes
item.description: American ski racer Breezy Johnson won the Olympic downhill Sunday with a hard-charging run on a day marred by teammate Lindsey Vonn’s crash that saw her being taken off the mountain in a helicopter.

item.title: How many footballs are used for the Super Bowl?
item.description: During a baseball game, foul tips and home runs repeatedly send balls into the crowd, but how many footballs will there be for the NFL’s biggest game on Sunday, Super Bowl LX in Santa Clara?

item.title: FBI concluded Epstein wasn’t running a sex trafficking ring for powerful men, files show
item.description: The Epstein investigation began in 2005, when the parents of a 14-year-old girl reported she had been molested at the millionaire’s home in Palm Beach, Florida. Police would identify at least 35 girls with similar stories.
